Reference impl: scipy (butter+filtfilt+hilbert; Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the Hilbert-band PLI with an independent scipy pipeline, checks the sign formula, and recovers ground truth with the volume-conduction contrast (zero-lag -> PLI~0 while PLV~1; lagged -> PLI high; independent -> both ~0); reports the real-EEG PLI + PLV, the scipy agreement, the exact formula, and the constructed-signal PLV/PLI
